milestones.outcome: Source search uses the pinned RE2 implementation directly in core with externally stable matching and no regex adapter.
exit_criteria: BPR-1618 AC1: pinned production RE2/Abseil audit supports the scoped owner exception without broad effect permission.
BPR-1618 AC2: core-only and public composition use the same core-private engine; regex adapter is removed.
BPR-1618 AC3: matching, errors, limits and shared/cache/concurrent use remain externally stable.
BPR-1618 AC4: boundaries, dependency/package contracts, focused composed search and format/documentation gates pass.
milestones.boundary: One architecture and relocation milestone; no search semantics, UI, dependency pins or RFC-wide closeout change.
